about.title: Tauri App Template
about.description: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Hover over settings to see what they do

generalSettings.clearAllDataDescription: Permanently delete all data and fully reset the application.
generalSettings.resetPreferencesDescription: This will reset all settings to their default values. Your data will not be affected.
generalSettings.resetApplicationDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your database, logs, and settings.
generalSettings.typeToConfirmPlain: Type 'Yes, delete all my data' to confirm.
generalSettings.preferencesResetSuccess: Preferences have been reset to defaults.
generalSettings.onboardingDescription: Re-run the initial setup process again.
generalSettings.telemetryDescription: Manage anonymous usage data and error reporting.
generalSettings.telemetryStatus: Opt-in to help us improve the app with anonymous data.

cliSettings.description: Manage the command-line interface for tauri-app-template.
cliSettings.usageDescription: Once installed, you can use the CLI from any terminal to interact with the application database and perform system tasks.
cliSettings.pathNoteDescription: The installer will attempt to add the CLI to your system's PATH. You may need to restart your terminal or log out for the changes to take effect.

appearanceSettings.title: Appearance
appearanceSettings.restartDescription: Some changes require a full application restart to take effect.

backupSettings.createManualBackupDescription: Please provide a name for this backup to identify it later. Manual backups are never automatically deleted.
backupSettings.confirmRestoreDescriptionPlain: This will overwrite your current data with the selected backup. The application will restart immediately to complete the process.
backupSettings.confirmDeleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this backup? This action cannot be undone.

debugSettings.title: Debug Tools
debugSettings.minimizeToTrayDescription: Keep the application running in the background when closed.
debugSettings.notifyWhenMinimizedDescription: Show a system notification when minimized to tray.
debugSettings.developerToolsDescription: Enable browser context menu (Inspect Element, Reload).
debugSettings.debugModeDescription: Enable detailed debug logging. Changes require a restart.
debugSettings.nativeFeaturesDescription: Test OS notifications and native dialogs.
debugSettings.crashTestDescription: Force a crash to test the Error Boundary.
debugSettings.exportDiagnosticsDescription: Export application logs and system information for bug reports.
debugSettings.testNotificationBody: This is a test notification from the Settings page!
debugSettings.nativeDialogMessage: This is a native dialog provided by the OS.

welcomeStep.title: Welcome to Tauri App Template
welcomeStep.description: We're glad you're here. Let's take a moment to personalize your experience so everything looks and feels just right.

animationStep.title: Experience
animationStep.animationsDescription: Enjoy fluid transitions and micro-interactions. Turn this off if you prefer a snappier, reduced-motion interface.

telemetryStep.title: Help us improve
telemetryStep.description: We'd like to collect anonymous usage data and error reports to help us identify issues and improve the application. This data is strictly anonymous and does not contain any personal information.
telemetryStep.optInDescription: You can always change this later in Settings.

backupInfoStep.title: Safe & Secure
backupInfoStep.description: Your data is stored locally. Automated backups are enabled by default to prevent data loss.

finishStep.title: You're all set!
finishStep.description: Your preferences have been saved. You can always change them later in the Settings menu.

errors.unexpectedError: An unexpected error has occurred. We've logged this issue for investigation.

updateSettings.title: Application Updates
updateSettings.description: Manage automatic and manual application updates.
updateSettings.resetAutoCheck: Reset automatic update checks to default
updateSettings.autoCheckDescription: Check for new versions in the background when the app starts.
updateSettings.noUpdateDesc: You are running the latest version of the application.
updateSettings.relaunchDescription: The update has been downloaded and is ready to install. Relaunch the application now to complete the update.
updateSettings.downloadSuccessDesc: The update has been downloaded and installed successfully. Please relaunch to apply changes.
updateSettings.downloadFailed: Failed to download and install update
updateSettings.packageManagedDesc: This installation is managed by your system's package manager. Use the following command to update:
updateSettings.debCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade tauri-app-template
updateSettings.cliManagedByApp: CLI updates automatically with the application.
